criteria.criterion: At a normal, breaking, or same-version upgrade, a missing or non-identical .vloop/README.md is generated in the configured language using the current binary version; an identical file causes no README line.
criteria.evidence: internal/cli/upgrade.go:63-78 resolves language, renders vloopReadme for the binary version, compares exact bytes, and emits no README change when identical; lines 79-94 repair same-version repositories, while lines 101-132 place README repair in the normal/breaking change list. upgrade_test.go:128-176 checks missing, edited and current files in en and es; lines 179-204 check breaking repair.

criteria.criterion: A real same-version repair prints updated .vloop/README.md before already at <version>; --dry-run prints would update .vloop/README.md before already at <version> and leaves the file byte-for-byte unchanged.
criteria.evidence: internal/cli/upgrade.go:79-94 prints the README action and then the unchanged existing already-at line, with dry-run bypassing the write. upgrade_test.go:142-168 asserts both exact output sequences and exact preservation of the edited bytes on dry-run.

criteria.criterion: A breaking upgrade without --yes includes .vloop/README.md in the proposed changes when it needs repair and writes nothing; --yes or a normal upgrade applies the repair alongside the existing upgrade writes.
criteria.evidence: internal/cli/upgrade.go:68-70 appends the README change to the shared change list; lines 115-143 list without writing for dry-run/refused breaking upgrades and apply all listed changes for approved upgrades. upgrade_test.go:58-81 and 117-124 cover normal and breaking output, while lines 179-204 assert a refused breaking upgrade preserves bytes and --yes repairs with the target version.

criteria.criterion: For the same language and version, init and upgrade produce byte-identical README content, and no other upgrade file's content or output changes.
criteria.evidence: internal/cli/upgrade.go:67 uses the same vloopReadme renderer as init.go:113, and upgrade_test.go:134-151 compares restored bytes to init output. The remaining upgrade merge/write logic is unchanged; cmd/vloop/b5_e2e_test.go:259-260 and upgrade_test.go:52-123 change earlier exact expectations only by the new README line.

criteria.criterion: Committed Go tests cover missing, edited, current, dry-run, same-version, and breaking-upgrade cases in both language resolution and exact-output contexts, including earlier tests changed only by the new README line.
criteria.evidence: internal/cli/upgrade_test.go:128-176 runs missing, current, edited, dry-run and same-version exact-output assertions for both en and es; lines 179-204 covers refused and approved breaking repair. Earlier exact assertions in lines 52-123 and cmd/vloop/b5_e2e_test.go:259-260 are changed solely to include the new README output line.

notes: The Go check log reports the repository test suite passing, including internal/cli and cmd/vloop.
